description: The team LifeStraw (communal water filtration backup) did not arrive via Yellowknife cargo in time.
response: Most crew members had personal LifeStraws — this individual redundancy saved the objective. The missing item was mission-important but not mission-critical.
lesson: For all safety and water-related equipment, maintain personal redundancy for communal kit. Build a 'critical redundancy list' of items where individual backups are warranted regardless of communal supply.
pattern_tag: critical-item redundancy for individual safety gear
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.6 Logistics and safety, lines 803-808. Register Crew tag: 'C16'. Sol: not stated; inferred to be discovered during arrival gear unpacking. Confidence (B) rationale: logistics-narrative entry; classified Near-Miss since personal redundancy prevented the missing item from becoming an actual mission failure.
